title: add cannot set deps or short-title; park and unpark cannot take a note

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
`add` has `--size --tree --findings --status --pass --id` but not `--depends-on` or
`--short-title`, so every item with a dependency is two commands: `add`, then
`set --depends-on`. `ops.add` already accepts both kwargs — only the CLI does not wire
them. Separately, `done` takes `--note` but `park` and `unpark` do not, so a park's reason
("waiting on upstream") has nowhere to go; `set_status` already threads `note`.

Both are the shared `ops` layer supporting a flag the CLI never exposed. The highest-
frequency daily friction on the roadmap, and the cheapest.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `add --depends-on` sets the dependency in one command.
2. `add --short-title` sets it.
3. `park --note` and `unpark --note` record the note in the log.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Wire `--depends-on` (repeatable, like `set`) and `--short-title` onto `add`, passing them
through to `ops.add`. Add `--note` to `park` and `unpark`, threading into `set_status`.
No `ops` change needed.

**Not in this slice:** `--flag`/`--group` setters, which are S12.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Implemented add --depends-on (repeatable) and --short-title, plus park/unpark --note through existing operations. Review found no additional issues. Thirteen focused tests and an installed-slicer smoke test passed, covering dependency gating, short-title persistence/rendering/defaults/newline rejection, notes with default/custom statuses, JSON and rendering. Full suite: 455 tests, 451 passed, 1 skipped, 3 existing workspace-isolation failures tracked by S54. slicer check and git diff --check pass.
